name: Review then fix
why: One agent reads the code and lists what is wrong. A second one fixes exactly that list.

steps.text: /review-verify Review the changes on this branch. List every real problem with file:line and a concrete fix. Do not change any code.
Apply the fixes the review just listed, one at a time, and say which you skipped and why.

name: Plan, build, check
why: Think first, build second, prove it third — the three steps people skip when they are in a hurry.

steps.text: /plan-build Plan this in small steps I can check one at a time. Stop after the plan.
Build step 1 of that plan. Only step 1.
/testing Run the checks on what was just built and fix anything that fails.

name: Research then write
why: Send one agent to find the facts, then hand them to a second one to write it up.

steps.text: /knowledge Research this properly and come back with sources, not memory.
Write this up using the research above. Keep it short and say what is still unknown.

name: Second opinion
why: Ask a fresh agent to attack the first one's answer. Cheap way to catch a confident mistake.

steps.text: Explain what you just did and why you believe it is correct.
Here is another agent's work in this repo. Try to prove it wrong. Report only what you can show with evidence.
